rows.text: The summary sheet dates the 7th Encontro 31 May-3 June 1990 (Anhembi), says it elected the 5th Diretório Nacional, and gives the slate results (slate 2, 'Articulação da Luta Socialista', headed by Lula, 56% and 46 DN seats); it reports no separate presidential vote. Its sources include Boletim Nacional nº 51 'de julho de 1990'.
